description: Physical parameters and non-idealities of the double-cart lab rig (examples/pendulum-double-cart-lab): absolute values with nominal, min, max and unit. The single source of the rig: design/design.py builds the design model and the bond graph from the nominal values (design/lablib.py: design_plant), the realism screen (design/screen.py) and RL step R1 (plan/RL_PLAN.md) and the robust classical designs (plan/ROBUST_CLASSICAL_PLAN.md) randomise over the ranges (lablib.sample: uniform between min and max, integers for integer ranges; min == max is fixed). 'group' says which effect of the screen a parameter belongs to (lablib.EFFECTS); 'per' what one value applies to. Link build: an aluminium tube 20 x 2 mm with a clamp hub at its pivot (shaft stub and the diametric encoder magnet), on link 1 a head at the tip (the bearing block of joint 2 with two 688 ball bearings and the joint-2 encoder board) and the joint-2 encoder cable along the tube, on link 2 a tip cap. Every part is lumped into the link's mass, centre of mass and inertia (lablib.link_props: a point mass or small cube per part, the tube as a thin-walled cylinder, parallel-axis theorem). Encoder layout: the encoder of joint k (AS5048-class magnetic, 14 bit) has its board on the body below the joint (the cart for joint 1, link 1's head for joint 2) and its magnet on link k at the pivot; the joint-2 cable runs down link 1 and crosses joint 1, the cart's cables run through a cable chain. Cable springs are neutral at the upright. The drive is voltage-mode (PWM H-bridge, no inner current controller): the 'current loop' is the armature's own lag L_m / R_m. The bond graph and the plant FMU have the belt compliance (k_belt, d_belt); the Python twin is belt-rigid and the screen checks the belt mode on the linearisation.

lab.actuator: 24 V brushed DC servo motor (90 W class, 7-segment commutator) with a 3:1 gearbox and a 16 mm toothed-belt pulley; 1000-line incremental encoder on the motor; voltage-mode PWM drive

L1.description: Link 1 length, joint-1 axis to joint-2 axis

L2.description: Link 2 length, joint-2 axis to the tip (where the push acts)

m_tube1.description: Aluminium tube 20 x 2 mm of link 1 (0.305 kg/m)

m_tube2.description: Aluminium tube 20 x 2 mm of link 2

tube_od.description: Outer diameter of the tubes (for the tube inertia)

com_shift1.description: Shift of the tube's own centre of mass towards the tip, as a fraction of the link length (wall-thickness variation, glue, plugs)

com_shift2.description: Shift of the tube's own centre of mass towards the tip, as a fraction of the link length

m_hub1.description: Clamp hub of link 1 at joint 1 (8 mm shaft stub, clamp, screws, magnet holder), at the pivot

m_head1.description: Head of link 1 at its tip: the joint-2 bearing block with two 688 bearings, the tube clamp and screws (the encoder board is m_enc_board)

m_hub2.description: Clamp hub of link 2 at joint 2 (8 mm steel shaft in the joint-2 bearings, clamp, magnet holder), at the pivot

m_tip2.description: Tip cap of link 2 (end plug with a rubber bumper), at the tip

s_hub.description: Size of a hub for its own inertia (a cube, J = m s^2 / 6)

s_head.description: Size of link 1's head for its own inertia (a cube)

s_tip.description: Size of link 2's tip cap for its own inertia (a cube)

m_enc_board.description: Encoder board with connector and screws; the joint-2 board sits on link 1's head (the joint-1 board is part of m_cart)

m_enc_magnet.description: Diametric magnet and holder, on each link's hub at the pivot

rho_cable.description: Mass per length of the joint-2 encoder cable (6-wire SPI) along link 1

m_cart.description: Cart: carriage, belt clamp, joint-1 bearing block, joint-1 encoder board, share of the cable chain

J_cart.description: Cart inertia about its centre of mass (bond graph only: the rail holds the cart's rotation)

tc_joint1.description: Coulomb (breakaway) friction of joint 1, a pair of shielded 688 ball bearings; smooth form tc tanh(w / eps_joint). The screen (screen_results.json) gives the budget

tc_joint2.description: Coulomb (breakaway) friction of joint 2, a pair of shielded 688 ball bearings; smooth form tc tanh(w / eps_joint)

eps_joint.description: Velocity scale of the smooth Coulomb law (numerical, fixed)

b_carriage.description: Viscous friction of the carriage on its linear guide and of the belt

tc_carriage.description: Coulomb friction of the carriage on its linear guide, the belt and the cable chain

b_motor.description: Viscous loss of the motor bearings (x (N/r)^2 = 0.070 N s/m at the cart)

tc_motor.description: Coulomb friction at the motor shaft: brushes, bearings, gearbox (x N/r = 0.375 N at the cart)

eps_base.description: Velocity scale of the smooth Coulomb law on the cart (numerical, fixed)

k_cable.description: Bending stiffness of the joint-2 encoder cable loop across joint 1 (joint 2 has no cable across it); neutral at the upright

b_cable.description: Damping (drag) of that cable loop across joint 1

k_cable_base.description: Spring of the cable chain along the rail, neutral at the rail centre

b_cable_base.description: Drag of the cable chain along the rail

R_m.description: Armature resistance with the leads and the drive's on-resistance (hot winding up to +20 %)

L_m.description: Armature inductance; with R_m the current lag of the voltage-mode drive, tau = L_m / R_m (0.33 ms nominal: the twin's current loop)

k_t.description: Torque constant = back-EMF constant k_e (V s/rad), +-5 %

J_m.description: Rotor inertia with the gearbox input stage, at the motor shaft (x (N/r)^2 = 0.49 kg at the cart)

N_gear.description: Gear ratio, motor turns per pulley turn (exact)

r_pulley.description: Effective (pitch) radius of the belt pulley

k_belt.description: Belt stiffness between pulley and cart (bond graph and FMU; the twin is belt-rigid, the screen checks the belt mode on the linearisation)

x_rail.description: Free travel of the cart centre to the soft end stops, +-x_rail

k_stop.description: Stiffness of the rubber end stops (bond graph; the twin counts a run that reaches x_rail as failed)

joint_bits.description: Resolution of a joint encoder (AS5048-class: 2 pi / 16384 = 3.8e-4 rad); the screen compares 16 and 18 bit

joint_noise.description: White angle noise of a joint encoder before quantisation (assumed for an AS5048-class sensor; check the datasheet of the part used)

base_res.description: Cart position resolution: the 1000-line (x4) motor encoder through gearbox and pulley, 2 pi r / N / 4000

base_noise.description: Cart position noise (an incremental encoder has none beyond its resolution)

delay.description: Whole-sample delay from sampling to the applied voltage: sample, compute, PWM update (integer)

ripple_rel.description: Commutation torque ripple, relative to the motor force

ripple_per_rev.description: Ripple periods per motor revolution (7 commutator segments x 2)

cogging.description: Cogging force at the cart (motor cogging torque x N / r)

cogging_per_rev.description: Cogging periods per motor revolution (7 slots, 2 poles)

push.description: Tip push perpendicular to link 2 for RL episodes and robustness runs (the balance design recovers 0.90 N from upright, 0.87 N with 2 ms delay: design/design.json push_max)
